    Explicit polynomial bound on cumulative brick counts #

    Second assertion of Theorem 5.2 (thm:walls): for an E-finite algebra of rank n ≥ 2 over any field, the number of isomorphism classes of bricks of composition length at most m is at most 2(n - 1)(m + 1)^{n(n - 1)} (sharpBrickGrowth_of_isEFinite, right_brick_count_le_of_isEFinite).

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.sharpBrickGrowth_of_isEFinite {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (h : IsEFinite R) (r m : ℕ) (hr : (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard = r + 2) :
    (bricksOfLengthLE m).ncard ≤ 2 * (r + 1) * (m + 1) ^ ((r + 2) * (r + 1))
    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.right_brick_count_le_of_isEFinite {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (h : IsEFinite R) (m : ℕ) :
    have n := (simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ).ncard; 2 ≤ n → (bricksOfLengthLE m).ncard ≤ 2 * (n - 1) * (m + 1) ^ (n * (n - 1))

    Theorem 5.2 (explicit bound): For an E-finite algebra of rank n ≥ 2, at most 2(n - 1)(m + 1)^{n(n - 1)} isomorphism classes of right bricks have composition length ≤ m.
